issue.title: Retire agent_holds
issue.description: Beta gate for the %hold prompt directive.

task_type_fields.remove_when: every sase-11l phase has landed and the flag-removal phase makes %hold unconditional.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: any non-bare %hold fails to parse with an error naming the flag; bare %hold is inert prose; editors hide it.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: %hold parses, arms durable holds at launch submission, and appears in editor completion.

payload.entry: Removed the agent_holds registry/schema entry and deleted the disabled %hold branches in Python launch parsing/arming and Rust directive/editor/LSP contracts; targeted Python and Rust hold tests pass.
